restaurantName: Shen Ji Mai Xia Mian Pi Dian
address: 2 Wangyang Road, Linhai, Taizhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: For over 20 years, this longstanding restaurant has been serving a unique noodle dish from Linhai City – mai xia. Wheat flour batter is scraped into a boiling broth to make soft, chewy noodles that curl like shrimps. Try their version with ‘three delicacies’: marinated beef shank, clams and shrimps, alongside fried egg and shredded radish. Whether it’s for breakfast or a late-night supper, a bowl of delicious mai xia always hits the spot.
pageTitle: Shen Ji Mai Xia Mian Pi Dian
